# EXP5
## Directory
```{r data directory}

data_dir <- file.path("..", "figs_data", "EXP2-2_CMPD_condilevel_data_260121.xlsx")
```

## General Parameter
```{r parameter}

# =========================
# Basic size parameters
# =========================

# =========================
# Factor levels
# =========================
outcome_levels <- c(
  "LowerOutcome",
  "Uncertain",
  "HigherOutcome"
)

situation_levels <- c(
  "Uncertain46",
  "Uncertain37",
  "Uncertain28"
)

x_labels <- c(
  "Uncertain46" = "U46",
  "Uncertain37" = "U37",
  "Uncertain28" = "U28"
)

# =========================
# Bar
# =========================
bar_width     <- 0.8
bar_linewidth <- 4
bar_alpha     <- 0.95


# =========================
# Point
# =========================
point_size  <- 16
point_alpha <- 0.3


# =========================
# Errorbar
# =========================
errorbar_width     <- 0.10
errorbar_linewidth <- 1.45


# =========================
# Axis
# =========================
axis_linewidth <- 1.45
tick_linewidth <- 1.15
tick_length    <- 4.5

y_min       <- 0
y_max       <- 105
y_break_min <- 0
y_break_max <- 150
y_break_by  <- 20


# =========================
# Legend
# =========================
legend_show <- TRUE

legend_x <- 0.5
legend_y <- 0.97

legend_size <- 50

legend_key_width <- 2.4

legend_text_margin_r <- 40
legend_text_margin_l <- 10


# =========================
# Significance parameters
# =========================
sig_y_low  <- 98
sig_y_mid  <- 98
sig_y_high <- 102

sig_height   <- 1
sig_margin   <- 0.6
sig_interval <- 0.02

sig_linewidth <- 1.25
sig_size_star <- 18
sig_size_ns   <- 14

sig_color <- "black"
```

## Allocation
```{r EXP3_PMPD Allocation}
# 读取 Excel 文件
data <- read_excel(data_dir, sheet = 'Allocation')


#### 提取risky下三个情境的Gratitude/Allocation
exp_data <- data[data$Outcome == 'HigherOutcome',]

tmp_data <- data[data$Outcome == 'LowerOutcome',]
exp_data <- rbind(exp_data, tmp_data)

tmp_data <- data[data$Outcome == 'Uncertain',]
exp_data <- rbind(exp_data, tmp_data)
####

### one-factor ANOVA
print('【Exp3】')

# 使用tapply计算平均值和标准差 
means <- tapply(exp_data$Value, list(exp_data$Outcome, exp_data$Situation), mean)
std_devs <- tapply(exp_data$Value, list(exp_data$Outcome, exp_data$Situation), sd)
cat("Means:", means, '\n')
cat("Standard Deviations:", std_devs, '\n')

```

```{r}
# 执行单因素方差分析
MANOVA(
  exp_data, dv = "Value", subID = "SubID", within = c("Outcome","Situation"), sph.correction = 'GG') %>%
  EMMEANS(effect = "Outcome", p.adjust = "bonferroni") %>%
  EMMEANS(effect = "Situation", p.adjust = "bonferroni") %>%
  EMMEANS(effect = "Outcome", by = "Situation",, p.adjust = "bonferroni")


```

### fig-Allocation
```{r, echo=TRUE}

output_path <- ".\\02_fig\\01_exp5_descri_stats_bar_CMPD_260613.svg"



# =========================
# Data process
# =========================
exp_data <- exp_data %>%
  mutate(
    Outcome = factor(
      Outcome,
      levels = outcome_levels
    ),
    Situation = factor(
      Situation,
      levels = situation_levels
    )
  )

summary_data <- exp_data %>%
  group_by(Outcome, Situation) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_value = mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(Value, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(Value))),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(exp = "mean")


# =========================
# Plot
# =========================
p <- ggplot() +
  
  geom_bar(
    data = summary_data,
    stat = "identity",
    aes(
      x = Situation,
      y = mean_value,
      color = Outcome
    ),
    width = bar_width,
    alpha = bar_alpha,
    fill = NA,
    linewidth = bar_linewidth,
    position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width)
  ) +
  
  geom_point(
    data = exp_data,
    aes(
      x = Situation,
      y = Value,
      color = Outcome,
      group = Outcome
    ),
    size = point_size,
    alpha = point_alpha,
    position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width),
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  
  geom_errorbar(
    data = summary_data,
    aes(
      x = Situation,
      group = Outcome,
      ymin = mean_value - se,
      ymax = mean_value + se
    ),
    width = errorbar_width,
    position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width),
    linewidth = errorbar_linewidth
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = fill_platte) +
  scale_color_manual(values = color_platte) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(y_min, y_max),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.0, 0.0)),
    breaks = seq(
      y_break_min,
      y_break_max,
      by = y_break_by
    )
  ) +
  
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = x_labels
  ) +
  
  xlab("Situation") +
  ylab("Allocation") +
  
  theme_pub()

save_pub(p, output_path)

rm(p, summary_data)
gc()


```

## fig-Allocation
```{r, echo=TRUE}

save_path <- ".\\02_fig\\03_descri_stats_bar_EXP3_RGB_260607.svg"

sig_y_low  <- 104
sig_y_mid  <- 104
sig_y_high <- 108

y_min       <- 0
y_max       <- 115
y_break_min <- 0
y_break_max <- 115
y_break_by  <- 20

# =========================
# Data process
# =========================
exp_data <- exp_data %>%
  mutate(
    Outcome = factor(
      Outcome,
      levels = outcome_levels
    ),
    Situation = factor(
      Situation,
      levels = situation_levels
    )
  )

summary_data <- exp_data %>%
  group_by(Outcome, Situation) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_value = mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(Value, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(Value))),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(exp = "mean")


# =========================
# Significance helper function
# =========================
add_sig_bracket <- function(
    x_left,
    x_right,
    y,
    label,
    text_size = sig_size_star
) {
  
  list(
    annotate(
      "segment",
      x = x_left,
      xend = x_right,
      y = y,
      yend = y,
      color = sig_color,
      linewidth = sig_linewidth
    ),
    
    annotate(
      "segment",
      x = x_left,
      xend = x_left,
      y = y,
      yend = y - sig_height,
      color = sig_color,
      linewidth = sig_linewidth
    ),
    
    annotate(
      "segment",
      x = x_right,
      xend = x_right,
      y = y,
      yend = y - sig_height,
      color = sig_color,
      linewidth = sig_linewidth
    ),
    
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = (x_left + x_right) / 2,
      y = y + sig_margin,
      label = label,
      color = sig_color,
      size = text_size
    )
  )
}

# =========================
# Significance data
# =========================
sig_df <- data.frame(
  situation_x = c(
    1, 1,
    2, 2
  ),
  
  comparison = c(
    "right", "whole",
    "right", "whole"
  ),
  
  label = c(
    "***", "***",
    "***", "***"
  ),
  
  y = c(
    sig_y_mid, sig_y_high,
    sig_y_mid, sig_y_high
  )
)

# =========================
# Significance layers
# =========================
sig_layers <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(sig_df))) {
  
  x0 <- sig_df$situation_x[i]
  comp <- sig_df$comparison[i]
  
  if (comp == "left") {
    x_left  <- x0 - dodge_width / 3 + sig_interval
    x_right <- x0 - sig_interval
  } else if (comp == "right") {
    x_left  <- x0 + sig_interval
    x_right <- x0 + dodge_width / 3 - sig_interval
  } else if (comp == "whole") {
    x_left  <- x0 - dodge_width / 3 + sig_interval
    x_right <- x0 + dodge_width / 3 - sig_interval
  }
  
  sig_layers <- append(
    sig_layers,
    add_sig_bracket(
      x_left = x_left,
      x_right = x_right,
      y = sig_df$y[i],
      label = sig_df$label[i]
    )
  )
}


# =========================
# Plot
# =========================
p2 <- ggplot() +
  
  geom_bar(
    data = summary_data,
    stat = "identity",
    aes(
      x = Situation,
      y = mean_value,
      color = Outcome
    ),
    width = bar_width,
    alpha = bar_alpha,
    fill = NA,
    linewidth = bar_linewidth,
    position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width)
  ) +
  
  geom_point(
    data = exp_data,
    aes(
      x = Situation,
      y = Value,
      color = Outcome,
      group = Outcome
    ),
    size = point_size,
    alpha = point_alpha,
    position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width),
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  
  geom_errorbar(
    data = summary_data,
    aes(
      x = Situation,
      group = Outcome,
      ymin = mean_value - se,
      ymax = mean_value + se
    ),
    width = errorbar_width,
    position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width),
    linewidth = errorbar_linewidth
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = fill_platte) +
  scale_color_manual(values = color_platte) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(y_min, y_max),
    breaks = seq(
      y_break_min,
      y_break_max,
      by = y_break_by
    )
  ) +
  
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = x_labels
  ) +
  
  xlab("Situation") +
  ylab("Gratitude") +
  
  theme_classic(base_family = "Arial") +
  
  theme(
    legend.position = if (legend_show) c(legend_x, legend_y) else "none",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.key.width = unit(legend_key_width, "cm"),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(
      size = legend_size,
      margin = margin(
        r = legend_text_margin_r,
        l = legend_text_margin_l
      )
    ),
    
    axis.title = element_text(
      size = title_size,
      color = "black"
    ),
    
    axis.text = element_text(
      size = text_size,
      color = "black"
    ),
    
    axis.title.y = element_text(
      margin = margin(r = title_margin)
    ),
    
    axis.title.x = element_text(
      margin = margin(t = title_margin)
    ),
    
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      margin = margin(r = text_margin)
    ),
    
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      margin = margin(t = text_margin),
      size = text_x_size
    ),
    
    axis.line = element_line(
      color = "black",
      linewidth = axis_linewidth
    ),
    
    axis.ticks = element_line(
      color = "black",
      linewidth = tick_linewidth
    ),
    
    axis.ticks.length = unit(tick_length, "mm"),
    
    plot.margin = margin(
      plot_margin_top,
      plot_margin_right,
      plot_margin_bottom,
      plot_margin_left
    )
  ) +
  
  sig_layers


# =========================
# Save
# =========================
ggsave(
  filename = save_path,
  plot = p2,
  width = width_in_inches,
  height = height_in_inches,
  units = "in"
)


```

## fig-Gratitude
```{r, echo=TRUE}

exp_data$Outcome <- factor(exp_data$Outcome, levels = c("LowerOutcome", "Uncertain", "HigherOutcome"))
exp_data$Situation <- factor(exp_data$Situation, levels = c("Uncertain46", "Uncertain37", "Uncertain28"))

# 计算每组的平均值和标准误差
summary_data <- exp_data %>%
  group_by(Outcome, Situation) %>%
  summarize(mean_value = mean(Value,na.rm=T), se = sd(Value) / sqrt(length(Value)))

summary_data$exp <- 'mean'

sig1_y <- 85
sig2_y <- 85
sig3_y <- 89
sig_seg_margin <- 0.6
sig_interval <- 0.02
sig_height <- 1

p2 <- ggplot()+
  # 绘制条形图和标准误差
  geom_bar(data = summary_data, stat = "identity", aes(x = Situation, y = mean_value, fill = Outcome), 
           width = bar_width,  position = position_dodge()) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#FFD06F", "#EF8A47", "#E76254")) +


  geom_errorbar(data = summary_data, aes(x = Situation, group = Outcome, ymin = mean_value - se, ymax = mean_value + se),
```

# Intention
```{r EXP3_PMPD Allocation}
# 读取 Excel 文件
data <- read_excel(data_dir, sheet = 'Intention')


#### 提取risky下三个情境的Gratitude/Allocation
exp_data <- data[data$Outcome == 'HigherOutcome',]

tmp_data <- data[data$Outcome == 'LowerOutcome',]
exp_data <- rbind(exp_data, tmp_data)

tmp_data <- data[data$Outcome == 'Uncertain',]
exp_data <- rbind(exp_data, tmp_data)
####

### one-factor ANOVA
print('【Exp3】')

# 使用tapply计算平均值和标准差 
means <- tapply(exp_data$Value, list(exp_data$Outcome, exp_data$Situation), mean)
std_devs <- tapply(exp_data$Value, list(exp_data$Outcome, exp_data$Situation), sd)
cat("Means:", means, '\n')
cat("Standard Deviations:", std_devs, '\n')

```

```{r}
# 执行单因素方差分析
MANOVA(
  exp_data, dv = "Value", subID = "SubID", within = c("Outcome","Situation"), sph.correction = 'GG') %>%
  EMMEANS(effect = "Outcome", p.adjust = "bonferroni") %>%
  EMMEANS(effect = "Situation", p.adjust = "bonferroni") %>%
  EMMEANS(effect = "Outcome", by = "Situation",, p.adjust = "bonferroni")


```
